# Co-write test fixtures

## maybean2.source.json

Ray Weiss's own composition "maybean2" (the Appendix N combat loop, developed by House Band as
"Maybe AN 2"), as a house-band-source-song. **Notes only:** pitches, beats, lengths, volumes and
Renoise note delays. No sample data: the original Renoise file also held third-party samples,
and none of that is here. Licence CC BY 4.0, credit "Ray Weiss".

How it was made (OSS-22, s462): the notes come from the appendix-n data module
`tools/score/ray-s332/ray-maybean2.data.mjs` (generated by `emit_js.py` from
`assets/music/source/ray-renoise-2026-07/maybean2.xrns`, commit `16956ae4`), converted with the
OSS-18 importer rules: one track per (Renoise track, note column) with id `T<track>c<col>`,
beat = line / 4 (LPB 4), the data's sounding pitch as MIDI (C4 = 60), volume as velocity, the
delay re-timed from the data file's 100 BPM to the song's 105 BPM as `offsetMs`, drum kind from
the instrument name, then `roleGuess`. Track names are the Renoise names (`Track 01`...).
`provenance.sha256` is the sha256 of the original `maybean2.xrns`. When OSS-18 lands, importing
`examples/co-write/appendix-n/maybean2.notes.xrns` should give the same notes.
